about: Round PACK2 (3 Nov 2026): the card on the front of a pack's wrapper is chosen by a rule (rpg/pack_faces.py: a set's highest-tier rare or mythic in its pack pool, ties to the one most often in the pool, then the name; a theme pack's highest-tier non-basic card, ties to the name). Name another card here to show it instead: "sets": {"M10": "Baneslayer Angel"}, "themes": {"JMP Angels 1": "Serra Angel"}. Empty to start.
